ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Students enrolling in this section must also register in the summer ISI Conference being held on the Urbana campus from June 13-18. There is a separate registration charge for the conference participation. Conference information and registration charges can be seen at: http://i2i.illinois.edu/2010_institute.php.
